faces.transcription: Take the target City card under the objective and add it to the hand of the player who completed this objective.
faces.flavor: You intercepted the courier and secured the MEDUSA sample. Before your team could interrogate, the courier took a cyanide pill. Analysis of the MEDUSA sample revealed it's biological, but nothing you've seen before. Not COdA. Not Smallpox. Not Anthrax.
